name: securacv_envsens
description: SecuraCV Environmental Sensors — internal die-temperature drift detector. Reads the ESP32-S3's built-in temp sensor once per minute, tracks an EMA baseline, and emits 'tamper_temp_drift' events on a sustained ≥5 °C step (case opened, device moved between rooms). No raw temperatures cross the privacy barrier — only the drift event with confidence.
